Hi all —

Thanks Rajesh — Wed 3/24 10:00 PT is great. A few technical notes to slot into the agenda so we can be efficient on the call:

- We’ll need a 30-minute maintenance window for the cutover, scheduled during your low-traffic period. Please confirm expected QPS/peak users for the first 24 hours post-cutover.
- Fallback policy: we propose a staged rollback (traffic split back to current endpoint 100% over a controlled 10-minute window) with an on-call SE to approve.
- KV cache warmup: we’ll run a warmup job; we’d like a test token/sample dataset to validate cache hit rates prior to full traffic.

I’ll attach the preliminary runbook and the checklist to the invite (attachment: redwood-rollout-checklist-v1.pdf). If you can share the sample dataset and a contact for the on-call engineer, that will help us finalize the timings.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks

dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Quick security items to add to the agenda:

1) KMS/key rotation: Will Acme be bringing their KMS? If so, we need the key rotation schedule and an admin contact.
2) Audit logs & retention: Confirm whether post-cutover logs will be retained in Acme’s tenant or forwarded to your SIEM. We need this for our runbook and alerting playbooks.
3) Scoped access for rollback: Which accounts are authorized to trigger the fallback; we should document the access control list before go-live.

Link to the security questionnaire and evidentiary checklist: https://redwood-security.example.com/questionnaires/acme-2026

I can take point on collating required evidence; Rajesh, please confirm the KMS and SIEM contact.
